== Danger Room Deed ==
[[{{ns:6}}:Danger Room Deed.jpg|right]]
'''Minimum Guild Level:''' 22

Add [[Danger Room|this amenity]] to your guild. (Will not be consumed if your guild already owns this amenity.)

Grants skill buffs to [[Disable Device|disable device]], [[hide]], [[Open Lock|open lock]], [[search]], and [[spot]].

Cost 180 AS
